articles.summary: Nabis has partnered with Hudson Distribution Services to acquire its New Jersey cannabis distribution license and warehouse lease, expanding Nabis' wholesale technology platform to the tri-state area. New Jersey brands and retailers can expect access to Nabis Marketplace, including real-time inventory, automated payments, and financing tools, in the second half of 2026.
articles.title: Nabis to Acquire Hudson Distribution Services’ New Jersey Cannabis Distribution License

articles.summary: Most cannabis brands aren't short on revenue. They're short on liquidity. When delivered product sits on net-30, -60, or -90 terms, that capital is tied up in your retailer's payment timeline, and the downstream costs compound across every outstanding invoice on your books. Nabis Capital is an invoice financing program that pays brands on qualifying invoices within 1 business day, with approval rates above 90% in California and 80% in New York. No bank relationship required. No personal guarantee. Nabis handles collections and assumes retailer credit exposure.
articles.title: What is Nabis Capital Cannabis Invoice Factoring?

articles.summary: Time Machine is a California cannabis brand founded in 2022 by the team behind Pacific Stone, greenhouse-grown in Carpinteria with a lineup built around smooth smoke, bold flavor, and a playful concept rooted in cannabis's long history. Their 28pk Fuel-Rod Pre-Roll was a first-to-market format that others followed. Their flower pouches keep climbing. This summer, their infused smalls line returns in a new format: a 14g THCa-infused pouch.
articles.title: Time Machine is a Playful Greenhouse Cannabis Brand for Adventurous Spirits
